Definition: a Ziphite or inhabitant of Ziph
BiblicalUsage: The Ziphites were the people of Ziph, and twice they went to Saul and told him where David was hiding. Their name also stands in the title of Psalm 54, where David cries out after they betrayed him. A whole town's name became a byword for betrayal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Ziphites warn me that loyalty is a choice made town by town and person by person, and that God hears the one betrayed.
